# Marathon Training Outline

## Weekly structure

- Monday: rest or mobility
- Tuesday: intervals
- Wednesday: easy recovery run
- Thursday: tempo run
- Friday: strength and light jog
- Saturday: easy run
- Sunday: long run

## Long-run fueling

Take carbohydrates every 30 to 40 minutes and practice the same gels you will use on race day.

## Injury prevention

- increase weekly volume gradually
- keep easy days truly easy
- stop if sharp pain changes your stride
